scope: current P4-P5 slice and binding P1-P12 future answer/input authority
finding: Players cannot fairly derive or guess a long hidden canonical sentence from an interpretive conclusion. The live slice claimed to validate meaning but used an exact prose whitelist.

binding_correction.exact_matching: allowed only when fair evidence or a transform yields the exact short value
binding_correction.interpretive_conclusions: use bounded physical actions, separate short claims, or deterministic meaning components
binding_correction.natural_paraphrases: must pass across reasonable synonyms and word order
binding_correction.input_shape: must be clear without revealing the deduction
binding_correction.handholding: not required; interface clarity is distinct from solution guidance

live_review_server.classification: guided technical proof with rejected answer shape
